thought: Make this a world and recap our internal progress every Monday.

draft.summary: Create an internal Weekly Work world and produce its canonical progress recap every Monday.
tradeoffs: Monday at 09:00 UTC is an explicit reviewable default, not a guessed local timezone.

The routine is hidden implementation of this complete reviewed intent. It reads canonical context first and appends a reversible internal recap; it does not infer with a model, send messages or execute arbitrary instructions.

scope.name: Weekly Work
scope.description: Scoped internal work with an explicitly reviewed recurring recap.
